snippet.title: Major Update Breakpoint - FBC: Firebreak (Community First Look)
snippet.description:
Since the launch of FBC: Firebreak, we’ve received a lot of feedback from you, the community. Major Update Breakpoint is the first big step for us to incorporate this feedback while bringing new features to the game. Let’s go through what you can expect from this update. 

The Hiss threat keeps on growing, and now the Mold is spreading through the Research Sector. The Oldest House is reaching a breakpoint, but Firebreak, ever adaptable, is ready to face this crisis.  

The first free Major Update, Breakpoint, is packed with systemic overhauls, new content, and quality-of-life improvements - all aimed at making FBC: Firebreak more fun, varied, and rewarding to play. Read our blog post for the full details of all the changes and new features:  https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2272540/view/530984095140809426?l=english 

FBC: Firebreak is a 3-player cooperative first-person shooter set within the enigmatic Federal Bureau of Control (FBC). As the Bureau’s headquarters faces a deadly and prolonged siege by otherworldly forces, only Firebreak—its most adaptable response unit—has the skills and courage to restore order. 

FBC: Firebreak is out now for PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5. 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272540/ 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/fbc-firebreak-fc3830 
Xbox Series S|X: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/fbc-firebreak/9pdcn8z4hkrn 
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012303/ 

Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment.  

Find out more at https://playfirebreak.com. 

Follow FBC: Firebreak: 

Twitter: https://x.com/ControlRemedy 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Control.Remedy/ 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/controlremedy/ 
Discord: https://www.discord.gg/control
